title: Clo In Paris: User Summit 2024 Highlights
description:
✨ A look back at our 2024 Paris User Summit! ✨

For the second year running, we had an amazing time bringing our users together for an exceptional day. Check out some of the best moments from this memorable event, where creativity and passion really shined. Huge thanks to all our guests for their energy and enthusiasm. Can’t wait to see you next year for an even more inspiring edition!

✨ Retour sur notre conférence d'utilisateurs 2024 à Paris ! ✨

Pour la deuxième année consécutive, nous avons eu le plaisir de réunir nos clients lors d'une journée exceptionnelle. Découvrez les moments forts de cet événement mémorable, où créativité et passion étaient au rendez-vous. Merci à tous nos invités pour leur présence et leur énergie. On se retrouve l'année prochaine pour une nouvelle édition encore plus inspirante !

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

summary: # Clo In Paris: User Summit 2024 Highlights ## Participant Introductions - **Lacoste:** Hello, I'm at Lacoste and I'm a tech designer for women. - **Balenciaga:** Hello, my name is Mathilde, I work at Balenciaga. - **Marroquinerie:** Hello, my name is Youssef, I'm a project development and innovation manager at Marroquinerie. - **Ochan Retail Company:** I'm Elisabeth Lombaud, I'm responsible for the 3D operational project for the Ochan Retail company. - **Pol Underwear:** Hello, my name is Philippine and I'm responsible for modeling activities at Pol Underwear. - **AceMod:** My name is Guy, I'm a 3D modeling teacher at AceMod. ## Personal Reflections on Using Clo - *Guy (AceMod):* I would say a dream, because I would have loved to have this earlier. When I work on clothes, I have fun, so I would say a dream. ## Value of the Event and Community - What I love about this kind of event is that there are brands that come to testify. - The tools respond exactly to the millimeter. It's great to be around people who, in the end, use it completely differently, and it brings us new things. - The conviviality, the exchanges, to see that the people I met two years ago continue to move forward. - We are on the right track and we just have to keep going. ## Observations on Clo Platform and User Engagement - Hey, there's this event I'm running right now. I'm going to step up to see all the developments and updates that have been integrated. - Clo has a real advantage; they are much closer to their users, which is great. - Lots of activities, the platform, we can see how it's evolving. - It's actually a great way to communicate on the same level. ## Clo as a Collaborative Tool in Fashion - It's really a tool that allows you to respect the creation and help the technician in your everyday life. - And what's great about this, in addition, is that these are conversations between the two of you. - Between technicians, between fashion geeks. That's really great. ## Importance of the Event for the Community - This kind of event is really important because there aren't many of us, and to be able to meet like this is really great. - It is with great pleasure that I observe the evolution of the collaboration that has been built between you and our Club Paris team. - See you very soon. Thank you very much.
markdown_content: ## Introduction: Participants and Roles at Clo In Paris User Summit 2024 This section introduces key participants from various fashion and technology roles attending the Clo In Paris User Summit 2024. It highlights the diversity of expertise, including tech design, 3D modeling, project development, and operational management within the fashion and apparel industries. - A tech designer specializing in women's fashion at Lacoste. - Mathilde, a professional at Balenciaga. - Youssef, project development and innovation manager at Marroquinerie. - Elisabeth Lombaud, responsible for 3D operational projects at Ochan Retail. - Philippine, head of modeling activities at Pol Underwear. - Guy, a 3D modeling teacher at AceMod. ## Value of the Clo User Summit: Community, Collaboration, and Innovation in Fashion Tech This section covers the participants' perspectives on the significance of the Clo User Summit, emphasizing community building, knowledge sharing, and innovation in 3D fashion technologies. - The event is described as a "dream" opportunity, especially for those working in clothing design and 3D modeling. - Participants appreciate the presence of various brands sharing their experiences and use cases. - The tools discussed respond precisely "to the millimeter," reflecting the accuracy and technical sophistication of Clo’s platform. - Networking and ongoing relationships formed at previous summits are highlighted as essential for continuous progress. - The event promotes convivial exchanges between technicians and fashion professionals, fostering new ideas and solutions. ## Clo Platform Advantages: User-Centric Development and Technical Support This section outlines key advantages of the Clo platform as discussed during the summit, focusing on user engagement, platform evolution, and the tool’s role in bridging creative and technical workflows. - Clo maintains close communication with users, allowing for rapid and relevant platform improvements. - The platform features continuous updates and developments visible to users, enhancing transparency. - Clo supports respectful collaboration between creative designers and technical teams, balancing artistic vision with practical implementation. - The tool facilitates direct conversations between users, including technicians and fashion enthusiasts, improving day-to-day work efficiency. - This user-centric approach and collaborative environment are vital in advancing digital fashion design and manufacturing processes. ## Summary of the Summit’s Impact and Future Outlook This final section reflects on the ongoing collaboration between Clo and the Paris user community, emphasizing the importance of such gatherings for a relatively small but growing field. - The event underscores the importance of face-to-face meetings among industry professionals who use Clo. - Long-term relationships and collaborations have been nurtured through these summits. - Continued evolution and partnership between Clo and its user base promise future advancements in 3D fashion technology. - Participants express enthusiasm for upcoming developments and further engagement with the Clo community. --- This document captures core insights from the Clo In Paris User Summit 2024, focusing on technical roles, platform capabilities, collaborative culture, and the event’s significance within the 3D fashion technology ecosystem.
